input: Reshingle the garden shed roof this spring

gold.taskTitle: Reshingle the garden shed roof this spring
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to replace the shingles on their garden shed roof during the spring season.

questions.title: What are the approximate dimensions of the shed roof?
questions.description: Understanding the roof size helps estimate materials, cost, and time needed.

questions.title: What type of shingles are currently on the roof?
questions.description: Knowing the existing shingle type clarifies whether like-for-like replacement is intended or an upgrade is planned.

questions.title: Will you do this yourself or hire a contractor?
questions.description: Determines whether the plan involves sourcing labour or focuses on a DIY approach.

questions.title: Is there a specific month in spring you are targeting?
questions.description: Pinning down a target date allows backward planning for purchasing materials and scheduling work.

questions.title: What is your approximate budget for this project?
questions.description: Budget shapes decisions on shingle type, tools to rent or buy, and whether to hire help.

questions.title: Are there any known underlying issues beyond the shingles?
questions.description: Identifies whether rotted decking, damaged flashing, or structural problems need addressing before reshinging.

questions.title: Do you already own the necessary tools for this job?
questions.description: Determines whether tool procurement or rental needs to be part of the plan.
